_readme.about: Tradetron strategy export. Edit and re-import via the ASB Import button.
_readme.logic: To change a condition's logic, edit its "conditionJson" (the AST). The "conditionValue"/"conditionDisplay" text is regenerated from it on import.
_readme.legs: For a leg field that has a "*Json" (e.g. "strikeJson"), edit the JSON — its text form is regenerated on import. Fields with no "*Json" (e.g. "qty") are plain text: edit them directly.
_readme.structure: Add/remove/duplicate legs, conditions or sets by editing the arrays.
_readme.do_not: Do not add "*_id" foreign keys back. Lists referenced by id must be ones you own.

name: Nifty 1Min Test Momentum Strategy
description:
Nifty 50 1-Min Fast Test Momentum Strategy (Native ATM Pattern)

Strategy Notes:

---------------

1. Purpose: Ultra-fast 1-minute candle momentum triggers with 1-point Spot_Confirm threshold to test and verify condition execution instantly.

2. Entry Triggers:

  • Time: 09:20 AM to 3:00 PM IST.
  • CE Signal: Nifty Spot 1-min close shows consecutive directional momentum (Close[-1] > Close[-2] + 1 pt and Close[-2] > Close[-3]).
  • PE Signal: Nifty Spot 1-min close shows consecutive downward momentum (Close[-1] < Close[-2] - 1 pt and Close[-2] < Close[-3]).

3. Position Builder: Uses Native ATM CE / PE leg selection (strikeType: ATM, strike: tt_ATM('NIFTY 50')).

4. Exit Conditions: Dynamic SL (10%) and Target (20%) relative to Traded Instrument entry price.
